Strawberry Liqueur
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 9:56pm

Ingredients




cup sugar
1 cup water
teaspoon concentrated strawberry flavoring extract
cup 100-proof vodka

Preparation

1 Make a simple syrup by bringing sugar and water to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring constantly to prevent scorching. When clear, remove from heat and let stand until just warm. Pour into clean 1-quart jar with tight-fitting lid. Add flavoring and vodka, cover, and shake well. This cordial may be served immediately, but it's better if allowed to age for 1 month. 2 Yield: approx 1 fifth
